title: Reading And Writing Mermaid Diagrams
summary: Learn Mermaid from readable flowcharts through software models, planning charts, and advanced documentation patterns with rendered examples and source-first practice.
audience: Developers, technical writers, and system designers who want maintainable diagrams that live beside code and documentation.

units.title: Syntax And Flowchart Fundamentals
units.summary: Read Mermaid declarations, node IDs, labels, shapes, edges, directions, decisions, and subgraphs from easy to detailed flowcharts.

units.title: Software Structure And Behavior
units.summary: Choose and write sequence, class, state, and entity-relationship diagrams for different software questions.

units.title: Planning, Data, And Advanced Authoring
units.summary: Use Gantt, user journey, pie, mindmap, timeline, and Git graph diagrams, then debug and review complex diagram source.
